theme: Light theme preferred for clinical trust and calmness.
archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST

typography.rules: Never center-align paragraphs. Use tight letter spacing for headings.

colors.rules: Use tinted greys. Ensure high contrast for all medical data. Do not use full-screen gradients.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces ONLY. No Glassmorphism for health apps to prevent visual refraction of data.
visual_enhancers.borders: Subtle borders (border-black/5 or border-stone-200) for definition.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadow with sharp 1px inner border.
visual_enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness (max 8px border-radius) or sharp edges. No pill-shaped cards.

layouts.landing_page: Mode A: Tetris Grid. Asymmetric bento grid, wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Overlapping elements for visual tension.
layouts.chat_app: Mode B: High Density Grid. Strict grid hierarchy, dense spacing (gap-4 or gap-6). Chat history sidebar and main chat area.
layouts.spacing_scale: p-1, p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-20, p-24, p-32. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical defaults.

components.chat_bubbles: User: Solid secondary (Calm Sage) with white text. AI: White surface with subtle 1px border. No generic tails.
components.medication_cards: Flat, rectangular cards with left-border highlighting severity color. Minimalist typography.
components.alerts: Terracotta background (10% opacity) with solid Terracotta text and border. Use lucide-react warning icons.
components.buttons: Primary buttons: Deep Forest Green (#1A3626). Sharp or slightly rounded edges, no full pills.
components.navigation: Visible navbar with brand name, links, CTA. Solid background, NOT transparent.

motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. NO 'transition: all'.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states must have higher contrast. Click/press states should translate-y-1 slightly.

hero_landing.description: Woman in cozy bedroom with laptop - represents calm, accessible home health tech

tech_feature.description: ECG graph on grid - for 'How it works' or analysis representation

clinic_trust.description: Smartwatch heart rate - represents biometric tracking and modern integration

media.rules: Do NOT use generic placeholder images. Constrain images to max-h-[80vh] on mobile.

icons.rules: Do NOT use emojis (e.g., 🤖, ⚠️, 💊) as icons. Always use proper SVG icons from the library.

accessibility.contrast: APCA contrast standards. Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
